e.body:
**IVASS（Istituto per la Vigilanza sulle Assicurazioni，意大利保险监管局）** 是**意大利的保险监管机构**。本条目同属本轮市场覆盖轴：实测池内**意大利相关条目接近于零**（仅有一条会议类条目误命中），而意大利是欧洲主要保险市场之一。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：首页 43.6KB；**统计栏目**下实测到两个专页——**《I principali numeri delle assicurazioni in Italia》（意大利保险业主要数字）** `/pubblicazioni-e-statistiche/statistiche/numeri-assicurazioni/index.html`（33.8KB）；**《Prezzi effettivi polizze cat-nat》（巨灾自然险保单实际价格）** `/pubblicazioni-e-statistiche/statistiche/prezzi-effettivi-polizze-cat-nat/index.html`（39KB）。同栏目另实测到：**月度《Bollettino di vigilanza》（监管公报）2026 年 6 月与 7 月期**、**《Quaderno IVASS》工作论文系列第 35 号**（2026 年，题目含 "Sensitivity Esti…"）、以及**巨灾自然风险的年度监测报告**（第四期）。⭐ **另有一处值得单列**：站点提供 **Open Data —「Metadati Agid」RDF**（`/footer/open-data/Open_Data_IVASS.rdf`，实测 **200，92KB，`application/rdf+xml`**），即**按意大利 Agid 开放数据标准发布的 RDF 元数据**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上意大利**——池内欧洲监管数据以欧盟层面（[[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[insurance-europe]]、[[aae-ai-act-position]]）与英法为主（法国见 [[acpr]]），**意大利此前为零**；**② 「巨灾自然险保单实际价格」是罕见口径**——多数监管源给**保费总额**，而这里给的是**实际成交价格的统计**，对**气候风险定价与保障缺口**研究直接有用（可与 [[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[perils-ied]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[dfa-climate-datasets]]、[[aegis-parametric]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]] 并读；意大利是欧洲地震与洪水暴露最高的市场之一）；**③ Quaderni 工作论文 + 月度监管公报**构成「**研究 + 监管动态**」两层，适合做监管执行与市场演变的连续观察（与 [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]]、[[governance-mcp]]、[[iso-42001-toolkit]]、[[frai]] 一类治理条目并读）；**④ 开放数据值得单独记一笔**——**以 RDF + 本国开放数据标准发布**在欧洲监管机构中并不常见（对照 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[osfi-canada-data]]、[[cmf-chile]]、[[ira-kenya]]）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① 内容以意大利语为主**（本次未核实英文版）；**②** 本次核实到**页面存在、栏目结构与文件类型**，**但未打开任何 PDF 或 RDF 内容**，因此**不能确认统计口径、覆盖期与更新频率**；**③** Open Data 文件名为「Metadati（元数据）」，**其实际提供的是元数据还是全量数据未核实**，故词条只写「RDF 元数据入口」而不夸大；**④** 本条目**不主张**该站提供精算模型或可直接入库的结构化数据集。**核实说明**：首页（43.6KB）、保险业关键数字页（33.8KB）、巨灾险实际价格页（39KB）、Open Data RDF（92KB，`application/rdf+xml`）均 HTTP 200 实测；公报与 Quaderni 链接在页面内实测可见；**未打开任何 PDF / 未解析 RDF**。
e.body_en:
**IVASS (Istituto per la Vigilanza sulle Assicurazioni)** is **Italy’s insurance supervisor**. This entry again belongs to the current market-coverage axis: a measured search found **essentially zero Italy-related entries** (only one conference item matched by accident), while Italy is one of Europe’s major insurance markets.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): homepage 43.6KB; two dedicated pages were found under the **statistics section** — **"I principali numeri delle assicurazioni in Italia" (key insurance numbers for Italy)** at `/pubblicazioni-e-statistiche/statistiche/numeri-assicurazioni/index.html` (33.8KB) and **"Prezzi effettivi polizze cat-nat" (actual prices of catastrophe-natural policies)** at `/pubblicazioni-e-statistiche/statistiche/prezzi-effettivi-polizze-cat-nat/index.html` (39KB). The same section also shows the **monthly "Bollettino di vigilanza" (supervisory bulletin) for June and July 2026**, the **"Quaderno IVASS" working-paper series no. 35** (2026, title containing "Sensitivity Esti…") and the **annual monitoring report on catastrophe-natural risks** (fourth edition). ⭐ **One item deserves separate mention**: the site publishes **Open Data — "Metadati Agid" RDF** (`/footer/open-data/Open_Data_IVASS.rdf`, measured **200, 92KB, `application/rdf+xml`**), i.e. **RDF metadata released under Italy’s Agid open-data standard**.

For RIAA: **① it adds Italy** — European regulatory data in the corpus is dominated by the EU level ([[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], [[insurance-europe]], [[aae-ai-act-position]]) and by the UK and France (France being [[acpr]]), while **Italy was at zero**; **② "actual cat-nat policy prices" is a rare measure** — most regulators publish **total premiums**, whereas this is a statistic of **actual transacted prices**, directly useful for **climate-risk pricing and protection-gap research** (readable with [[cat-bond-pricing]], [[perils-ied]], [[climate-conditioned-cat]], [[dfa-climate-datasets]], [[aegis-parametric]] and [[parametric-insurance-demo]]; Italy has among the highest seismic and flood exposure in Europe); **③ the Quaderni working papers plus the monthly supervisory bulletin** give two layers — **research and supervisory activity** — suited to continuous observation of enforcement and market evolution (alongside governance entries such as [[insurance-regulatory-mcp]], [[governance-mcp]], [[iso-42001-toolkit]] and [[frai]]); **④ the open data deserves a note of its own** — publishing **RDF under a national open-data standard** is uncommon among European supervisors (compare [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], [[apra-insurance-statistics]], [[osfi-canada-data]], [[cmf-chile]] and [[ira-kenya]]).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① the content is mainly Italian** (no English version verified here); **②** this check verified **page existence, section structure and file types** **but opened no PDF and parsed no RDF**, so **definitions, coverage periods and update frequency cannot be confirmed**; **③** the open-data file is named "Metadati" (metadata), and **whether it delivers metadata only or full data was not verified**, so this entry says "RDF metadata entry point" rather than overstating it; **④** this entry does **not** claim the site offers actuarial models or directly loadable structured datasets. **Verification note**: the homepage (43.6KB), the key-insurance-numbers page (33.8KB), the cat-nat actual-prices page (39KB) and the open-data RDF (92KB, `application/rdf+xml`) were all measured at HTTP 200; the bulletin and Quaderni links were observed on the pages; **no PDF was opened and the RDF was not parsed**.
e.body_hk:
**IVASS（Istituto per la Vigilanza sulle Assicurazioni，意大利保險監管局）** 是**意大利的保險監管機構**。本條目同屬市場覆蓋軸：實測池內**意大利相關條目接近於零**，而意大利是歐洲主要保險市場之一。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 43.6KB；**統計欄目**下實測到兩個專頁——**《意大利保險業主要數字》**（33.8KB）與**《巨災自然險保單實際價格》**（39KB）。同欄目另實測到：**月度《監管公報》2026 年 6 月與 7 月期**、**《Quaderno IVASS》工作論文第 35 號**（2026）、以及**巨災自然風險年度監測報告**（第四期）。⭐ 另有一處值得單列：站點提供 **Open Data —「Metadati Agid」RDF**（實測 **200，92KB，`application/rdf+xml`**），即**按意大利 Agid 開放數據標準發布的 RDF 元數據**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上意大利**——池內歐洲監管數據以歐盟層面（[[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[insurance-europe]]、[[aae-ai-act-position]]）與英法為主（法國見 [[acpr]]），**意大利此前為零**；**② 「巨災自然險保單實際價格」是罕見口徑**——多數監管源給**保費總額**，這裏給的是**實際成交價格統計**，對**氣候風險定價與保障缺口**研究直接有用（可與 [[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[perils-ied]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[aegis-parametric]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]] 並讀）；**③ Quaderni 工作論文 + 月度監管公報**構成「研究 + 監管動態」兩層；**④ 開放數據值得單記**——**以 RDF + 本國開放數據標準發布**在歐洲監管機構中並不常見（對照 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[cmf-chile]]、[[ira-kenya]]）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① 內容以意大利語為主**；**②** 本次核實到**頁面存在、欄目結構與文件類型**，**但未打開任何 PDF 或 RDF 內容**；**③** Open Data 檔名為「Metadati（元數據）」，**實際提供元數據還是全量數據未核實**，故只寫「RDF 元數據入口」；**④** 本條目**不主張**該站提供精算模型或可直接入庫的結構化數據集。**核實說明**：首頁、關鍵數字頁、巨災險實際價格頁、Open Data RDF 均 HTTP 200 實測；**未打開任何 PDF / 未解析 RDF**。
